description:
Morbid Metal arrives on Steam April 8.
🔗 Wishlist now to be notified of the limited time launch discount:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130

Morbid Metal is a stylish fast paced hack and slash roguelite set in a dark sci fi world. Switch characters instantly mid fight to chain abilities into devastating combos and tear through waves of lethal machines. Take risks to gain power and build momentum as you face cinematic, challenging bosses. Death is how you evolve. Break through the simulation.

🔗 Steam Page here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/

Developed by Screenjuice in Unity and published by Ubisoft.
